author: nateg
title: FAST swimmers qualify for state championships - NewsBreak
text: The Fort Atkinson Swim Team (FAST) is celebrating a major milestone as two of its athletes qualified for the Wisconsin State Long Course Swimming Championships, set to take place July 25–27 at the Walter Schroeder Aquatic Center in Brown Deer. Evren Thiess (age 10) and Laney Sonnentag (age 12) each qualified in two individual events, earning the opportunity to represent FAST at the state level after a strong summer of competition and dedication in the pool. In addition to the individual qualifiers, FAST will be sending a girls 11–12 relay team to compete at state. The team includes Laney Sonnentag, Cleo Knapp, Olivia Anderson and Sadie Schneider. Several other FAST swimmers will be competing at the regional championships this weekend in hopes of joining their teammates in Brown Deer. This achievement marks a proud moment for the Fort Atkinson swim community and highlights the hard work and progress of the team throughout the season. Coaches and teammates alike are excited to cheer on their representatives as they compete among the best swimmers in Wisconsin. Subscribe to Daily Jefferson County Union
